paragraphs.text: Masumaro (MAH-soo-MAH-roh; masu 増す "increase," "grow" or "double" + maro まろ male suffix) First to Live , is a kami on Kamigawa that was once a human.

Masumaro has retained some of his human shape, appearing as a robed monk with budoka equipment and a long green grass robe. His kami aspects are visible in that his face is surrounded by brightly glowing serpentine coils, forming a crown of light on his bald head while lotus flowers float in the air around him.
Masumaro was the first human on Kamigawa to live by the ways of the kami. He was once so revered by his people that his spirit became a kami . His descendants were still active during the Kami War .
